description: Session B non-tautological content criterion for the Phase 2 KG ablation (flag phase2_result). Each task carries content facts extracted ONLY from its oracle chunks; each fact is a case-insensitive regex over the answer text. Both arms can in principle match every fact (no oracle-chunk-ID requirement), so the metric measures answer content, not arm identity. Scoring: per-task fraction = matched facts / total facts; arm score = macro average over tasks; family breakdown reported. No LLM judge. Echo guard: no pattern may match the task question (enforced by --build-check); facts sourced from a chunk outside the task's oracle_ids are rejected.
provenance: fact statements copied from the oracle chunk text: 00_kg_icm_phase1_synthesis, 01_kg_icm_phase1_synthesis, 00_icm_implementation_pitfalls_and_failure_modes, 00_memory_eviction_forgetting_web_research
verdict_rule: ON wins if on_macro > off_macro AND ON strictly out-scores OFF on at least 2 of the 3 task families; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (n=9 pilot).
